rules.title: How it works
rules.fill: Fill every cell with a digit from 1 to {{k}}, or make it black.
rules.once: A digit appears at most once in a row or column.
rules.sums: The numbers beside a row and above a column are the sums of the groups of digits that touch, in order. A black cell splits two groups.
rules.check: All filled in? Tap Check. You see for each row whether it is right; right rows stay as they are. You may check {{max}} times.
rules.note: The ring is a note: a digit goes here, you don't know which yet.
rules.noClock: There is no clock. You can simply carry on later today.

done.solution: The solution is above; red is what you had differently.
